survey.sub_type_reason: Sheet is dominated by terminal strips (T/S S, T/S B, T/S C, PLUG C, PLUG D) with numbered terminals, relay coils Re1-Re6 driving valve motor contacts, and status endpoints (bilge switches) wired to a monitoring/alarm system (Main Panel PC Card with open/closed lamps) - characteristic of relay/terminal wiring diagrams rather than a distribution schedule or one-line power topology.
survey.notes: Sheet shows +24V service battery feed through F2 200A / F3 60A / SW8 / SO6 into terminal strip T/S S (local pump SW) and Main Bilge Pump motor. A parallel branch (Bilge Valves Q13 10A) feeds T/S B terminal blocks 8-13, each driving a relay (Re1-Re6) whose contacts route through T/S C's large numbered terminal field (1-50) to open/close contacts, bilge valve motors (M, engine room bilge valve type, qty 5) and bilge level switches for Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker. XA40/XA10/XA11 tags are status-signal taps to an external monitoring loom (not drawing cross-references, no sheet number given). Lower right shows Main Panel wiring: Plug C terminals to panel switches S20-S24 and lamp S13, an AUX plug, a Pedestal Alarm Mod with mute, then Plug D terminals continuing into a dotted-outline enclosure 'MAIN PANEL PC CARD' with open/closed indicator lamps for each bilge zone and a +24V supply rail with diodes. Small illegible fragments in title-block/legend area at far right/bottom (bleed-through of adjacent sheet text) - flagged as illegible duplicate text, not treated as separate regions. 'to ONYX' arrow near lower left is unresolved (no explicit dwg/sheet number visible) - recorded as cross_ref pending confirmation it's an actual pointer vs. status tap."
